about: Object avatars for demoing the bend rig: the steak and cactus from the voice note, plus a rubber duck. No Tripo rig: the app's bend rig roots the base and bends the top toward the face. Faceless on purpose; the app adds the face.
style: Fun, charming cartoon style like a polished stylized 3D game asset: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing saturated colours.

props.subject: a thick juicy T-bone steak standing upright on its narrow bottom edge like a little character, chunky cartoon grill marks, the T-shaped bone visible on one side, glossy and appetizing
a chubby rounded green cactus in a small terracotta pot, two short rounded side lobes curving upward, a little pink flower on top, soft cartoon spines drawn as tiny dots
a classic yellow rubber duck sitting upright facing the camera, rounded head on a rounded body, orange beak, no eyes
